message.content: {"label": "RISKY", "explanation": "The old `packages` decorator used `getmodule(fn).__name__` (full module path) as the service name fallback, but the new version uses `getmodule(fn).__name__.split('.')[-2]` (second-to-last component), and the old code also used `f\"{service}:{name}\"` with the unresolved `service` parameter (a bug), while the new code uses `f\"{_service}:{name}\"` — these combined changes alter plugin registration names, which could break plugin discovery for existing plugins that relied on the old (buggy) naming."}
